summary: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. (DBRG) filed an 8-K reporting stockholder approval of its merger into a wholly owned subsidiary of Duncan Holdco LLC, taking the company private. The special meeting held April 23, 2026 resulted in 121,177,032 votes for, 3,900,209 against, and 52,181 abstentions on 125,816,044 shares present. The merger agreement dated December 29, 2025 provides for Merger Sub I merging into DigitalBridge, with the company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. No price per share, premium, or advisor is disclosed in this filing; the transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory review. Watch for the expected close timeline and any potential dissenter appraisal rights or competing bids that could affect the risk-arb spread.
